title: charmmgui2cp2k: automated CHARMM-GUI/AMBER to CP2K QM/MM input generator
description: A terminal-native wizard (command-line and Textual TUI) that converts CHARMM-GUI QM/MM Interfacer / AMBER biomolecular setups into validated, immediately runnable CP2K QM/MM input files, with automated link-atom handling, boundary charge redistribution, spin-state risk analysis, and CP2K version-capability gating.
